description: In the Alto Valle of Río Negro, vegetable plots are irrigated from canals that close for winter, so the plot often sits bare until the next spring crop. I'm building Umbral to help growers use that gap without wasting seed, fuel and work. It compares leaving the plot as it is with a grass cover and a legume cover: whether the dates fit the last canal turns, early cold nights (NASA POWER), real parcels in a past season (NASA HLS), and what each cover is for. The grower decides.
